links.outcome: Fairness impact of including demographic and clinical metadata as inputs to multimodal medical AI
links.effect: Indiscriminate inclusion of all metadata may negatively impact fairness for protected subgroups. Analysis covered dermatology, radiology and ophthalmology (gender, age, skin tone) and more than 20 clinical attributes in dermatology.
links.quote: Our findings reveal that the indiscriminate inclusion of all metadata may negatively impact fairness for protected subgroups and show how multimodal AI utilizes demographic information in metadata to influence fairness.

unlisted_practices: Fairness-oriented metadata selection using a medical VLM to estimate fairness correlations as a resource-efficient guide for attribute selection

screen.reason: Empirically benchmarks how metadata inclusion influences fairness across demographic subgroups in medical vision-language models and evaluates a metadata selection strategy to safeguard algorithmic fairness.
